column6: AFV Loudness is the closest computational counterpart to the perceptual loudness observable property.
AFV Roughness is a direct computational correlate of the perceptual roughness observable property.
AFO 1.1 AudioFeature is the abstract superclass for all audio features, including timbral ones.
AFV TimbreDistribution is a concrete distributional feature model; the GMEOW observable property is the broader perceptual category.
AFV Onset is an onset detection function; timing deviation is a derived perceptual/computational property relative to a reference grid.
